subject: LGBTQ+ Student Support and Inclusive Handbook Policies
overview: The committee approved resolutions to enhance LGBTQ+ student support and transition to gender-neutral language in school handbooks. Presentations also covered middle school transitions, special education monitoring, and upcoming student travel.

items.title: Consent agenda and minutes approval
items.summary: Approved bills, payrolls, and minutes from April 3rd, with an amendment to clarify that students with disabilities have access to before and after school programs regardless of wraparound service availability.

items.title: Rules and Policy Subcommittee report
items.summary: Approved the March 28th subcommittee minutes and received an update on the ongoing revision of the district's bullying prevention and intervention plan.

items.title: Superintendent's report
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent reported on recent DESE classroom observations, vocational student projects, and a wide variety of upcoming community events and fundraisers.

items.title: Middle school transition presentations
items.summary: The principals of Andrews and McGlynn middle schools presented their plans for welcoming incoming sixth-grade students, including open houses and orientation activities.

items.title: SkillsUSA and Spain travel approvals
items.summary: Approved overnight travel for vocational students to Marlborough for competitions and a Spanish language immersion trip to Spain featuring host family stays.

items.title: Special education monitoring and enrollment update
items.summary: Joan Bowen outlined the state's Tiered Focused Monitoring process for the upcoming school year and provided a status update on current out-of-district student placements.

items.title: Resolution on LGBTQ+ student supports
items.summary: Approved a resolution directing the Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion subcommittee to review and recommend guidance for supporting LGBTQ+ students based on state and national standards.

items.title: Resolution on gender-neutral handbook language
items.summary: Approved a resolution to update 2023-2024 student handbooks with gender-neutral pronouns and to list gender identity and expression as protected categories.
